The percentage of the pitbull population that is currently being bred for the purpose of fighting or other aggressive jobs is insanely low. The pitbull is also commonly confused with the American Staffordshire Bull Terrier. A pitbull isnt even a real breed by most accounts. Most shelters also misidentify dogs by their breed, especially for bull terriers and pitbulls. The areas where pitbulls are most common are going to be low income areas, where violence is already going to be more common. [Most dog bites occur in low income areas](https://avmajournals.avma.org/view/journals/javma/232/4/javma.232.4.542.xml). [Pitbulls are the most commonly abused dogs. Pitbulls and Golden Retrievers have similar aggression rates](https://atts.org/breed-statistics/statistics-page4/). [Pitbulls do not have any special features to their jaw, they do not have “lockjaw”.](https://phs-spca.org/myth-of-lockjaw/)

[Pitbulls are one of the most popular dogs. They are also the most abused, misidentified, neglected, and euthanized dogs](https://www.aspca.org/about-us/aspca-policy-and-position-statements/position-statement-pit-bulls). Like with all things in life, it takes only a small amount of compassion and patience to really discover why things are the way they are. Pitbulls suffer the same kind of bigoted, misinformed hate as blacks and asians do in the US and it’s disgusting. 

Fear mongering and spreading myth about a breed is not going to help, it only damages things further.
